name: yt_media_forge
description: Sovereign video and audio synthesizer engine. Generates zero-cost high quality neural voiceovers using Edge-TTS, creates automated kinetic subtitles (.ass/.srt), stitches media scenes with Ken Burns pan/zoom effects, and renders 1080p horizontal or vertical 9:16 Shorts via native FFmpeg subprocess.

url.description: Target video/audio URL for bounded stream sampling (e.g. YouTube URL)

start_offset.description: Start offset in seconds for stream sampling (default 0)

duration.description: Duration in seconds for stream sampling (default 10, max 30)

scenes.description: List of scene image paths or color descriptions with durations

image.description: Absolute or relative path to image

audio_path.description: Path to audio voiceover file for video rendering

author: Flowork OS Sovereign Media Team
